mix.gains_note: Per-cue gain_db below are starting points relative to full scale on the fitted file, set from the library defaults and the script's 'low' and 'quiet' notes. S13 sets final levels by ear.
ducking: Beds (amb_crossing_stall, amb_godown_night, lyr_night_crickets) duck -6 dB under every line, 150 ms attack, 400 ms release.
Music ducks -8 dB under every line (library default).
Foley under a line (key ring, paper tremble, pen scratch) sits in the word gaps or at -24 dB and below; the key ring is never on a word.
l09 (whisper, 'चाय ठंडी हो गई।'): no effect at all under it; bed ducked a further -4 dB (total -10). The paper tremble is out before it starts.
l29 (DSP on the phone): bed and crickets duck to -14 dB below their level; nothing else plays on it except lyr_phone_line_hiss (script b10).

b12_l32: under l32 the bed drops to 'the bulb hum alone': low-pass amb_godown_night at about 250 Hz (leaves the hum, removes roof ticks and rustle) and mute lyr_night_crickets, from 0.3 s before l32 to the end of the episode. Music is out under l32 (see mus_tension_note). After l32: near silence, the hum and the returning note only.

filters.l29_dsp: Earpiece phone filter (library mix.phone_filters.earpiece): band-pass about 300-3400 Hz, light saturation, lyr_phone_line_hiss under it. Kept wide enough that every consonant survives; if 'बीस' loses its b, widen to 250-3800 Hz before anything else.
filters.b10_nandini: l26, l27, l28 are unfiltered: she is in the room.
filters.l11_through_steel: Nandini outside the closed shutter: low-pass about 2.5-3 kHz, -4 dB, a short metallic resonance (small plate or short room reverb, about 0.3 s, 15 per cent wet). Projected, not shouted (script): the take carries it; the filter only muffles. Must stay intelligible; if it does not, raise the cutoff before lowering anything else.
filters.l16_pushpa: Off frame but in the room: no filter.
filters.sfx_dead_line_tone: Band-pass about 400-3000 Hz (handset in Pushpa's hand, close and thin).

music_in_out: IN mus_theme_caper_slow on the pen click, b6 Shot 3. Builds through b7 and b8.
OUT mus_theme_caper_slow hard, on the first frame of b9 (headlights).
IN mus_tension_note with l30 (b11). Holds under the b11 silence and l31.
OUT mus_tension_note before l32 (0.4 s fade, gone by l32's first word).
IN again mus_tension_note after l32 for the final hold; hard cut with the last frame.
mix.loudest_event: The b5 shutter rattle is the loudest thing in the episode (script). Keep its true peak under -1 dBTP; it will not move integrated loudness much because it is short.
crowded_silences: b9 (1.2 s): headlight hum, idle cutting out, car door, steps and one peanut crack. Suggested order: hum + idle from 0.0, idle out at 0.5, door at 0.7, two steps 0.8-1.1, crack just before l23. Drop the steps first if it reads crowded. Everything settles before l24 (script).
b10 (1.0 s): key click (optional), 3-4 DTMF tones, one ring and the pick-up click. If it cannot sound natural in 1.0 s, lengthen the silence by up to 0.4 s and log it.
b4 (1.2 s): three blows about 0.4 s apart; their ring may tail under l10 only.

cues.why_not_library: Used once in the series (library one_offs list: 'paper on steel and pen rolling (b2), scale needle creak (b3)'). Two events folded into one generation to keep the count down.

sections.A: paper laid on steel and the pen rolling to a stop (b2)
sections.B: the scale needle's single spring creak (b3)

cues.prompt: On the steel platform of an old weighing scale in a quiet tin warehouse: a single typed sheet of paper laid flat on the metal with a soft papery slap, then a plastic ballpoint pen set down on it that rolls a short way across the steel and stops. A pause. Then the scale's needle spring gives one small, thin metallic creak. Close, dry, no voices, no music.

uses.anchor: section A at the head of Shot 2, about 0.4 s before l03; the roll stops before or just under l03's first word
uses.note: The sheet and pen across the scale. Ducked -6 dB if the roll runs under the line.

uses.anchor: section B in Shot 2 of the b3 silence, after the wood knock
uses.note: 'The dial needle has hardly moved': one small creak, -20 dB.

cues.fallback: If section B does not come back clean, drop the needle creak: the knock carries the beat. If section A fails, use sfx_paper_slip (one lay-down) and no pen roll.

cues.why_not_library: Library one_offs list: 'three blows on the steel shutter (b4)'. The library shutter take is a rattle and slam on the ground, not a fist on closed steel.
cues.prompt: Three heavy blows of a fist on a closed corrugated steel rolling shutter, heard from inside a large empty tin warehouse: each blow a deep booming metallic thud with a ringing shimmer, about half a second apart, then the ring slowly dying away. No voices, no footsteps, no music.

uses.anchor: all three blows inside the 1.2 s silence before l10 (about 0.4 s apart; tighten the spacing in the edit if the take is slower)
uses.note: D-016 direction 13 order: blows, his smile, her voice. The ring of the third blow may tail under l10 (ducked -12 dB) but must be fully decayed before l11 begins.

cues.fallback: If the take has more or fewer than three blows, cut it to three. If the spacing cannot fit 1.2 s, lengthen the b4 silence by up to 0.4 s and log it (D-0M2: the edit settles length).

cues.prompt: A single click of a retractable plastic ballpoint pen, dry, crisp and very close, in a quiet room. One click only, no reverb, no voices.

uses.anchor: on the pad insert (Shot 3), the last of the three silent stills, before l14
uses.note: Dry and close. mus_theme_caper_slow enters on, or a hair after, this click.

cues.prompt: Close foley on full jute grain sacks in a quiet warehouse: first a flat palm pressed onto a tight jute sack with a dry coarse rustle; a pause; then a small light object lifted off the rough jute with a faint scratch; a pause; then a heavy man settling his weight onto a stacked sack, the jute creaking and the grain inside shifting. No voices, no music.

uses.anchor: section B over Shot 3 of the b8 silence

cues.fallback: Any section that fails is dropped rather than regenerated; picture carries b7 and b8. Section C matters most: if it fails, retake this one cue once.

cues.prompt: A single metal truck key being slid out of an old truck's cab door lock with a short scrape and click, then a moment later the same key dropped into a cardigan pocket full of knitting wool: one soft, muffled metallic clink. Close, quiet, no voices, no music.

uses.anchor: section A on Shot 2 of the b8 silence; section B over Shot 3 (not shown, heard)
uses.note: The clink is 'the only telling of the pocket': it must be audible, -14 dB, and in the clear (no line on it).

cues.prompt: A dry roasted peanut shell crushed slowly in a closed fist: one short brittle crunch and crackle, close, in a quiet room. No voices, no music.

uses.anchor: at the end of the b11 silence, pre-lapping the cut into b12 Shot 1
uses.note: Off frame in b11, seen as the crushed shell in his fist in b12 Shot 1. Dry, close.

cues.fallback: If the take fails, use the single loudest crack of sfx_peanut_crack, pitched down about 2 semitones and doubled 30 ms apart, before retaking.
